architecture.heading: The Unity Systems Technical & Commercial Architecture
architecture.html:
The Unity Systems Technical & Commercial Architecture

Unity Systems packages peer-reviewed algorithms and industrial software engineering into modular, self-contained libraries across three decoupled lifecycle layers. Every component is available free for open-source/academic research and commercially licensed for proprietary enterprise deployment.

01 // DATA_CURATION

Data Curation, Drift & Spatial Telemetry

Automated local dataset preprocessing, Parquet lineage versioning, continuous distribution drift detection (AILifecycleKit), and high-precision visual/spatial telemetry vector extraction (EyeArt Engine).

02 // MODELING_ENGINES

Neuro-Symbolic & Graph Modeling Engines

Domain-specialized deep learning and Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) pipelines for structural proteomics (ProtGram-DirectGCN) and unsupervised modularity-based entity resolution in large-scale knowledge graphs (ModER-GraphER).

03 // VISUALIZATION_REPORTING

GPU Compute & Immersive Visualization

Ultra-low-latency C++, CUDA, OpenGL, and WebGL rendering engines for multi-million particle simulations (CudaParticles Engine), stereoscopic VR raymarching (RaymarcherVR Engine), and structural cross-linking inspection (VisInt-X).

DATA_CURATION Python / Parquet / Lineage

AILifecycleKit

Lightweight Python SDK engineered to automate local dataset curation, data preprocessing, deterministic lineage versioning, and real-time tensor drift evaluation in production AI pipelines. 

import ailifecyclekit as alk
tracker = alk.DriftTracker(baseline_dataset="v1_clean.parquet")
anomalies = tracker.evaluate_stream(incoming_tensor, threshold=0.85)
tracker.commit_lineage(export_path="./metadata/")

DATA_CURATION + MODELING_ENGINES Python / Medallion Lakehouse / GNN / ER

DataIntegrationToolkit (DITK)

Unified, high-performance Lakehouse Engine for Scalable Entity Resolution (ER), Graph Representation Learning (GNN & GraphOG), Biomedical NLP Knowledge Integration, and Bioinformatics Proteomics built on a tiered Medallion storage model (Bronze → Silver → Gold). 

import dataintegrationtoolkit as ditk
lakehouse = ditk.Lakehouse(storage_root="./lakehouse")
bronze = lakehouse.ingest(source="records.csv", tier="bronze")
silver = lakehouse.resolve_entities(bronze, blocker="minhash_lsh", matcher="dwm")
gold = lakehouse.export_knowledge_graph(silver, format="gnn_pyg")

faq.heading: Enterprise Licensing & Fulfillment FAQ
faq.html:
Enterprise Licensing & Fulfillment FAQ

How Unity Systems delivers commercial licenses, private package tokens, and custom engineering agreements.

Do you offer customized Master Service Agreements (MSAs)?

Yes. If your corporate legal or procurement team requires customized indemnification limits, vendor onboarding, or an enterprise-wide site license instead of individual developer seats or compute nodes, contact us directly to execute a custom MSA.

How is the commercial key & package delivered?

Upon license execution, your engineering team receives a unique authentication token for our private PyPI and compiled binary registry along with a counter-signed legal PDF copy of your commercial license agreement.

When do I need a Commercial License vs. AGPLv3?

If you are using our libraries for academic research or open-source software released under a compatible license, the $0 AGPLv3/MIT tier applies. If you embed our libraries into a proprietary product, internal commercial pipeline, or hosted network service without disclosing your source code, a Commercial License is required.

Can Unity Systems build custom extensions for our stack?

Yes. Beyond off-the-shelf component licensing, Unity Systems provides bespoke R&D consulting to integrate our AI lifecycle, biomedical graph, and GPU visualization engines directly into your enterprise data infrastructure.
